title.en: Cell: The Building Block of Life

blurb.en: See inside plant and animal cells and learn what each part does.

highlights.en: Watch water cross a membrane, then explain why the potato pieces changed
Zoom from a leaf into a chloroplast and see where food is made
Build bacterial, plant and animal cells in the Cell Kit game
Follow one cell as it copies itself and divides
Ten lessons, about four hours, with a review game in each

caption.en: A leaf cell and its chloroplasts
The path of the light in a microscope
How a protein leaves the cell
Cell Kit: build three kinds of cell
A short question with four choices

description.en: Ten lessons on the cell, in the order of the Class 9 chapter. You look through a school microscope, watch water move across a membrane, open up the parts of a plant and an animal cell, and follow one cell as it divides. Each idea ends with a few short questions.

modules.title: Cell: The Building Block of Life

lessons.title: What is a cell, and where did cells begin?
How do we see and measure cells?
How do substances cross the cell membrane?
What is the membrane made of, and why do plants have a wall?
What is inside a cell, and how do cells differ?
Which parts hold the instructions and make the proteins?
Which parts give energy, make food and store materials?
How do cells grow and divide?
What does the cell theory say, and do cells live forever?
